Class StaffMenu

java.lang.Object
App.StaffMenu
public class StaffMenu extends Object
Handles all menu display and operation logic specific to the CareerCentreStaff role. This class provides methods for administrative functions such as authorizing company accounts, approving internships, managing withdrawals, and generating reports.

    • authorizeCompanyReps

      public void authorizeCompanyReps(CareerCentreStaff staff)
      Manages the authorization process for new CompanyRepresentative accounts. Staff can approve or reject pending representatives. Approved accounts are moved from the pending list to the registered accounts map.
      Parameters:
      staff - The currently logged-in CareerCentreStaff member.

    • approveInternships

      public void approveInternships(CareerCentreStaff staff)
      Manages the approval process for new Internship opportunities. Staff can view pending internships and choose to approve (making them visible) or reject them.
      Parameters:
      staff - The currently logged-in CareerCentreStaff member.

    • manageWithdrawalRequests

      public void manageWithdrawalRequests(CareerCentreStaff staff)
      Manages student withdrawal requests for applications. Staff can view all applications with a Application.WithdrawalStatus.PENDING and choose to approve (marking the application as Application.ApplicationStatus.WITHDRAWN) or reject the request.
      Parameters:
      staff - The currently logged-in CareerCentreStaff member.

    • generateReports

      public void generateReports(CareerCentreStaff staff)
      Guides the staff member through filtering internships and generating a report. This method collects the filter type (Status, Level, or Major) and the filter value, then delegates the actual filtering and display to CareerCentreStaff.generateReport(List, String, int).
      Parameters:
      staff - The currently logged-in CareerCentreStaff member.

    • viewAllInternships

      public void viewAllInternships()
      Displays details for all internships currently registered in the system.
